overview: The blue SCX10 III Coyote is a 1/10 trail and crawling purchase with a deliberately narrower Pro-Line body and a competition-oriented equipment direction. It is more substantial than the micro crawlers in this batch, so its attraction is room to explore real rock lines rather than desktop convenience. I would shortlist it for a driver who values the chassis and tire package more than a licensed full interior.

sections.heading: The simplified body suits a driver who wants to use the obstacles.
paragraphs: The blue SCX10 III Coyote is a 1/10 trail and crawling purchase with a deliberately narrower Pro-Line body and a competition-oriented equipment direction. It is more substantial than the micro crawlers in this batch, so its attraction is room to explore real rock lines rather than desktop convenience. I would shortlist it for a driver who values the chassis and tire package more than a licensed full interior. The standard AXI-2036T2 reviewed here is separate from the battery-inclusive RTR Plus.

The exact purchase in this guide is Axial SCX10 III Coyote AXI-2036T2, Blue · standard RTR without battery/charger. Its 1/10 scale, 4WD drivetrain and brushed power system identify a complete assembled vehicle. That combination should be matched to trail driver wanting a simpler competition-oriented 1/10 rtr before a promotional feature becomes the reason to order. Decide where the car will be driven most often, because a usable nearby space can be more valuable than a longer feature list. The dated manufacturer documentation supplies the hardware facts, the Amazon API supplies listing identity, and outside coverage remains the work of its named author. Our preference is an editorial interpretation of those sources. It does not turn the published claims into personal driving experience or measured results.

sections.heading: The standard RTR stops before the battery and charger.
paragraphs: The assembled truck has fitted power electronics, radio and servo, but the drive battery and charger are extra for AXI-2036T2. Four AA transmitter cells are included, so they should not be counted as another required purchase. This precise distinction matters because Greg Vogel's RC Driver coverage discusses both the standard package and RTR Plus. Choose a compatible 2S or 3S LiPo with appropriate physical fit and charging equipment. A bundle photograph from the other package does not change this ASIN's inventory.

For SCX10 III Coyote, the stated drive-power arrangement is compatible 2S or 3S LiPo · extra, and the radio package is Spektrum SLT2; SR515 receiver. Required completion is explicit: Compatible drive battery and charger; transmitter AA cells included. Make a physical inventory before buying additional equipment. The finished vehicle already coordinates the body, drivetrain and installed controls, but correct operation still requires the model's startup and charging procedure. Check the pack leads and connectors without pulling on their wires, inspect steering travel before running, and confirm the transmitter power arrangement against the actual holder. If an item differs from the exact AXI-2036T2 list, resolve that with the seller or manufacturer while the purchase details are available. A package discrepancy should not be covered up by ordering a replacement and assuming every similarly named RTR comes with the same components.

sections.heading: Portals and front overdrive are more useful than a power headline.
paragraphs: The Coyote uses AR45P portal axles, LCXU transmission and a 35T 540 brushed motor with Spektrum 40A control. Axial also documents front-axle overdrive. Portal gearing raises the axle center clearance, while overdrive changes the front-to-rear wheel-speed relationship. Those mechanisms can help a crawling setup in different ways, but we have not measured a climbing advantage. Keep the factory arrangement as the starting point and understand the required maintenance before treating each feature as an automatic competition result.

The documented Axial 35T 540 brushed; Spektrum 40A ESC is the power equipment evaluated for SCX10 III Coyote. For a crawling vehicle, reduction, tire support and controllable application of power matter more to the buying case than a maximum-speed headline. A trapped tire also loads the drivetrain, so choose another approach rather than applying prolonged power against a stall. Start from the original AXI-2036T2 gearing and battery specification. Keep optional electronics purchases separate until the stock configuration reveals a specific requirement worth changing.

sections.heading: The receiver has more capacity than the basic transmitter.
paragraphs: The factory SLT2 transmitter provides the initial two-channel driving controls, while the SR515 receiver has additional channel capacity and its own compatibility requirements. That does not mean every optional function can be operated from the supplied radio without further equipment. The low-speed purpose favors smooth control and deliberate line choice rather than full output. RC Driver supplies attributable current Coyote coverage, including its own rock running. We do not present that as our drive test or promise the same outcome on a different local course.

The SCX10 III Coyote control system is listed as Spektrum SLT2; SR515 receiver. Treat the manual as the reference for binding, reversing, neutral settings and any assistance function supplied with this exact package. Radio frequency alone does not establish compatibility with a replacement transmitter or receiver. Check steering trim on the surface you intend to use, then verify response in both directions before a demanding session. For shared casual use, explain how to stop and shut down the vehicle before handing the controls to another driver. If the car behaves incorrectly, distinguish a setting issue from physical binding. A new electronic part is a poor first response when the existing linkage is prevented from moving freely.

sections.heading: The new mount positions are tools for an owner who takes notes.
paragraphs: Axial describes revised shock towers, panhard mounting, skid plate and boat-side trays alongside multi-link solid-axle suspension. Those changes provide concrete subjects to inspect rather than a vague claim that the Coyote is another Base Camp body. The oil shocks and stainless links still require checking for free motion through articulation. Preserve the factory positions before moving mounts, and investigate tire interference or steering bind at the source. More adjustments are useful only when you can explain which problem a change is intended to solve.

The published construction for SCX10 III Coyote is one-piece steel frame; ar 45p portal axles; lcxu transmission. Those details describe what an owner can inspect and maintain; they do not provide a measured suspension or steering score. Use the original mounting positions as a reference and check movement before changing springs, shock positions or link lengths. Its listed wheelbase is 312 mm published, which makes exact replacement compatibility more useful than a generic Axial parts search. Confirm tire clearance through steering travel and suspension movement with the body installed. Change one mechanical setting at a time, record the new position and return to the baseline if the result becomes confusing. A good tuning process should explain the change you are seeking, rather than replace several components at once and leave you unable to identify which one helped.

sections.heading: Trepador tires and dual-stage foams make a coherent rock package.
paragraphs: The Maxxis Trepador tires sit on KMC Grenade wheels with dual-stage open-cell inserts. The softer outer foam and firmer inner support are documented equipment choices, not measured grip figures. They help define the intended crawling purchase more clearly than the blue shell alone. Choose dry initial lines with room to approach and reverse, then inspect the tires and steering after the session. A portal axle does not eliminate every belly hang-up or prevent the vehicle from rolling on a steep side slope.

The SCX10 III Coyote tire package is Maxxis Trepador; KMC Grenade wheels; dual-stage foams. Its intended terrain listing is off-road. Begin on a surface that lets you observe a consistent response, then adjust the course rather than immediately blaming the tire. Leave a safe route to reverse or retrieve the truck on a technical line, and evaluate the whole obstacle instead of only the front axle’s approach. The published dimensions are 445 × 235 × 197 mm. They help plan the space and transport requirements, but they do not establish measured grip, rollover angle or jump behavior.

sections.heading: Clipless access should make the inspection routine easier.
paragraphs: The Pro-Line Coyote body removes without conventional clips and exposes the chassis for pack changes and maintenance. Its contoured shape is meant to provide obstacle and tire clearance, which is a practical reason to buy it even without a licensed full-scale badge. Check the latch fit and wiring after body removal, and avoid routing the battery lead where the shell can trap it. We have not measured body retention or impact resistance. The official manual and exploded view are the evidence for how the truck is assembled and serviced.

The reviewed Blue · standard RTR without battery/charger SCX10 III Coyote is supplied as a complete vehicle with a finished body, rather than a replacement shell or bare platform. The official photographs show the exact package and relevant details; their staging is not our test record. Learn how the shell is secured before forcing access to the battery area, and protect any leads that cross between body and chassis. After running, inspect wheel attachment, steering movement and dirt accumulation, then consult the AXI-2036T2 drawing for part identification. A correct replacement number can be more useful than an expensive upgrade when the original component simply needs servicing. Body material, metal gears or aluminum construction describe the hardware, but none is treated here as evidence of crash resistance or a long-term reliability rating without physical testing.

sections.heading: A micro 4Runner is an alternative only when the scale requirement changes.
paragraphs: The gray SCX24 4Runner is a complete battery-inclusive 1/24 crawler suited to small technical areas. It cannot reproduce the Coyote's 1/10 footprint or portal chassis simply because both are crawling vehicles. Choose the Coyote for larger rock lines, a standard-size service environment and its purpose-focused body. Inspect the 4Runner when storage, indoor use and Toyota hard-body detail are more important. The comparison explains the space and completion tradeoff; it does not claim that one wins a common obstacle test.
